headings.usage: Use Outfit for all display headings, prominent numeric data (e.g. check-in times), and dashboard summary metrics.

body.usage: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, forms, data tables, and system labels. Its sterile, structural form fits government applications perfectly.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) adapted for Government

primary.description: Deep Institutional Maroon. Use for primary CTAs like Check-in buttons, active states, and core branding. Commands authority and trust.

background.description: Crisp white and soft off-white to maintain the high contrast and clarity required by institutional apps.

foreground.description: Near black for maximum readability. No light gray text.

status.description: Status colors for attendance badges. Ensure text contrast over soft tinted backgrounds.

admin_dashboard.structure: Sidebar on left (fixed), top navbar (sticky with glassmorphism), main content area. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
admin_dashboard.components: Shadcn tables for attendance logs, summary cards (col-span-1), and charts (col-span-2 or 3).

employee_app.structure: Bottom navigation bar (fixed, glassmorphism) on mobile screens. Top header with WFO/WFH toggle. Main bento-grid layout for 'Today's Status', 'Check-in CTAs', and 'Recent Logs'.
employee_app.components: Massive tactile CTAs for Check In/Out. Cardless dense UI or minimal 1px border cards. Focus on frictionless interaction flow.

login_page.structure: Left/Top: Institutional branding and login form. Right/Bottom: Government advertisement banner.
login_page.components: Form with clear labels, full-width button. The ad banner should use the provided background images.

spacing_strategy.padding: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Section gaps of py-12 or py-16.
spacing_strategy.alignment: Left-align forms and data tables. Center-align only the main Check-in/out CTA on the employee mobile view.

cards.style: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-gray-200), no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.

glassmorphism.usage: Use ONLY for sticky headers or bottom mobile navs. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-gray-200.
glassmorphism.note: Do not use for main content cards to preserve high legibility required by government apps.

ctas.style: Solid Maroon background, crisp edges (rounded-md), hover state darkens to #5c0000. For the massive Check-in button, consider a subtle Neumorphic inner shadow to make it feel tactile.

motion.hover: Transition transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease on interactive elements.
motion.check_in_flow: Micro-interaction: Button press scale down (0.95), loading spinner, success checkmark animation.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet WCAG AA against background. Maroon (#800000) on white is >7:1.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='employee-check-in-btn', data-testid='admin-login-btn').
accessibility.language: All UI text must be in Bahasa Indonesia.

components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Left-aligned labels. Use IBM Plex Sans.
components_instructions.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Dense rows for data density.
components_instructions.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for the Selfie Camera capture and Geofence alerts.
components_instructions.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn Chart) for Admin attendance summary charts (Bar/Line). Use solid colors.
components_instructions.toasts: Use Sonner for success/error notifications (e.g., 'Check-in Berhasil', 'Di Luar Area Kantor').

images.category: Government Dashboard Header Background or Content Banner

icons.usage: Use clear, universally understood icons. No playful/emoji icons.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only for sticky navigation menus, do not use it for content cards.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles. For government apps, use crisp sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-md) with clear interaction animations and the Maroon brand color.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Theme: Strictly Light mode. Government institutional portals require high legibility and an authoritative, paper-like clarity.
The UI MUST be completely localized in Bahasa Indonesia.
DO NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions (dropdown, calendar, toast). Use Shadcn components for these.
